name: 调芯滚子轴承低噪耐用款
description: 轴承钢精选材质、低噪高精度运转、多密封规格可选的工业质感套图

styleLock.backgroundSystem: alternating dark graphite textured backdrops #17191C with mirror-reflection floors and light paper-grey panels #EFEFEF
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool 5500K studio light, upper-right rim key on dark screens, even high-key on light screens, controlled metallic highlights, soft contact shadows
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte carbon-textured dark floor with subtle mirror reflection; matte paper-grey light panels
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; bold Chinese headlines, pill badge rows, oversized low-opacity ghost English category word; no mixed fonts
styleLock.iconSystem: signal red #D0021B circular medallion icons with thin-line glyphs, thin red connector lines, square checkbox glyphs, rounded rectangular cards
styleLock.presentationRules: product always centered and stable in scale, rendered in its true metallic finish, mirror reflection on dark floors, never floating; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
noDrift: no floating product without contact shadow
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent industrial premium tech ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of dark graphite textured background #17191C, light paper-grey panel #EFEFEF, charcoal text #2D2D2D, and signal red accent #D0021B; cool temperature; modern geometric sans-serif typography with bold Chinese headlines, pill badge rows, and oversized low-opacity ghost English category words; signal red circular medallion icons with thin-line glyphs, thin red connector lines and rounded rectangular cards; cool 5500K studio lighting with upper-right rim key on dark screens and even high-key on light screens, controlled metallic highlights, soft contact shadows and subtle mirror reflections on dark floors; product always centered, stable in scale, rendered in its true metallic finish; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 9 片详情页长图切片（800x1200，重叠 60px）提炼。已剥离：源顶部 LOGO 徽标、“瑞士进口/德国进口/百年传承”产地与传承文案、“品质保证/超长质保/原装正品”等承诺词、面板 9 的会员促销贴片与二维码、重复图标文案。图面标题作“调芯滚子轴承”，疑为通行品名“调心滚子轴承”的异写，leaf 按图面文字保留；源文件夹名为“五金”，图面内容确为轴承类五金件，品类一致，L2 取 taxonomy 精确串“五金”，为库内新品类 leaf。图面文字较清晰处：三栏大字“高/50次/密”抽象为 {callout} 文案槽位由使用方填写；应用领域卡片为灰色示意场景块，标签（轨道轴承/航天航空）仅作场景参考，由使用方替换。
